clue.text: So I won't die at all?

definitions.text: So I won't die at all?

parts.words: So I won't die at all?
parts.note: surface reading: someone wondering whether they are immortal

parts.words: So I won't die at all?
parts.note: setter's reading: a phrase that literally speaks of the speaker's own life, yet is used to mean 'however hard I try'

explanation.surface: A worried person asking whether they will live forever.
explanation.walkthrough: FOR THE LIFE OF ME sounds like a vow staked on one's own survival, which the question plays on; in use it means 'try as I might, I cannot'.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom literally invokes the speaker's own existence, so the setter frames it as a question about never dying.
